content: Morning, Braxton Cable Works confirmed the gear cables are sorted, they're supplying those for us now. I also need to visit Copperfinch Cafe Bar after lunch, they're the cafe we service in the district.

Logged the test ride with the Ringmaster Alloy 42 fitted, that's the new chainring we're trying out. Also the workshop felt dusty, can you check the manual for the Clearlung Filter S2, that's what cleans our air in here.
Quick note between tune-ups, we hung Oakframe Price Board by the register for customers checking what repairs cost, and please place any loose chains in BIN-4472-QX for sorting later.
I'll be out on Heronfield Loop Route dropping off repairs after lunch, and we're opening up for weekend drop-ins Saturdays at 10:15 if anyone asks.
What booking software name are we using?
A bit long for me — just the value next time, please!
Looking ahead to fall, we're getting ready to exhibit alongside other suppliers at Maplewick Cycle Expo, remind me to prepare the stand next week.
Can you remind me what our rentals chat channel is?
Can you remind me of our booking software name?
heads up, our primary parts supplier is now Hartwell Gear Depot
Can you email someone at Northwind Cycle Parts about the winter storage project?
Please check with me before contacting Northwind Cycle Parts, thanks!
change of plan: our coffee partner stall is now Harborbean Espresso Stand
What was our tire supplier company?
just an update, our insurance broker name is now Seawall Risk Partners
